name: SOC Capstone Team - Part 1 Detection Coverage (ATT&CK v19)
description: 10 tested Wazuh detection rules across 6 tactics (Execution, Persistence, Credential Access, Stealth, Defense Impairment, Lateral Movement, Command and Control), including 2 Linux rules and 1 temporal correlation rule.

techniques.comment: Rule 100005 (Level 10): PowerShell encoded/download cradle via Sysmon Event 1
Rule 100201 (Level 14): LSASS memory read via Sysmon Event 10
Rule 100203 (Level 8): Linux crontab execution via auditd SYSCALL/EXECVE
Rule 100202 (Level 10): Linux SSH authorized_keys write via auditd file watch
Rule 100204 (Level 8): RDP Logon Type 10 from non-local IP (Event 4624)
Rule 100205 (Level 9): Suspicious rundll32 proxy execution (ATT&CK v19 Stealth TA0005)
Rule 100206 (Level 9): Registry Run/RunOnce SetValue via Sysmon Event 13
